{{Quote|The smell of orange cliff-moss. Ghoral bird calls. Our favorite booth at the Gorge and Gab. All of it, gone.|A resident of Makeb|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
The '''Gorge and the Gab''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before Makeb's [[Conquest of Makeb|invasion]] by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].<ref name="RHC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>
